# Vortexia Bot

> Vortexia Bot (also called Vortexia Discord Bot or Vortexia) is a free all-in-one Discord bot.
> Official website: https://vortexia.run.place/

## Primary brand names
- Vortexia Bot
- Vortexia Discord Bot
- Vortexia

## What Vortexia Bot does
Lavalink music, antinuke, moderation, tickets, economy, levels, AI, media notifications, Minecraft tools, 200+ slash and prefix commands.
